settingsTile.label: Payment gateways
settingsTile.description: The one gateway your store checkout and Sales invoices use to take online payments.
settingsTile.keywords: payment gateway, razorpay, stripe, checkout, pay link, online payment, card, upi

common.noAccessTitle: You do not have access to this page
common.noAccessMessage: Ask a workspace admin to give your role the permission for it.

network.title: Cannot reach the server
network.message: Check your connection and try again.

forbidden.title: Not allowed
forbidden.message: Your role does not allow this.

conflict.title: Changed by someone else
conflict.message: This record changed while you had it open. Reload it and try again.

validation.title: Please check the form
validation.message: Some values are not valid. Check the highlighted fields.

unavailable.title: Not available yet
unavailable.message: This part of the store is not available on this server yet.

rateLimited.title: Too many requests
rateLimited.message: Wait a moment and try again.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.message: It was removed or never existed.

planLocked.title: Not on your plan
planLocked.message: Your plan does not include the store. Upgrade to use it.

couponCodeTaken.title: Code already used
couponCodeTaken.message: Another coupon already uses this code. Choose a different one.

groupCodeTaken.title: Code already used
groupCodeTaken.message: Another group already uses this ordering code.

orderNoPhone.title: No phone number
orderNoPhone.message: This order has no buyer phone number, so nothing can be sent.

gatewayNotConfigured.title: No payment gateway set up
gatewayNotConfigured.message: Set up a payment gateway first. Its keys are missing or it is switched off.

gatewayUnavailable.title: Gateway not available
gatewayUnavailable.message: This gateway cannot make a payment link a buyer can open.

paymentLinkFailed.title: The gateway refused the link
paymentLinkFailed.message: Check the keys and that the amount is above the gateway minimum.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.message: Try again. If it keeps happening, share the request ID with support.
